flashcard_questions.q: The tendency of atoms to achieve a full outer shell of electrons, typically eight, through bonding.
The formation of chemical bonds between atoms through the transfer or sharing of electrons.
A type of chemical bond formed when one atom transfers one or more electrons to another atom, creating oppositely charged ions that attract each other.
Which ion does a sodium atom form when it reacts with chlorine?
